method: Weighted mean of general-election polls ending on or before each date. Weight = 0.5^(age_days/21) x sqrt(sample_size/600) x quality (0.5 + NYT numeric_grade/3, 1 if unrated) x 0.5 if partisan-sponsored or internal, divided by sqrt(k) where k is the recency-weighted number of polls from the same pollster. One question per poll (likely voters preferred over registered over all adults). Undecided / someone else / would not vote are excluded from the mean, so shares do not sum to 100. Band = 95% interval: sqrt(sampling variance of the weighted mean, design effect 1.3 + (2.5 pt house/non-sampling SD)^2 / effective number of polls), floored at +/-4 pts when there are 2 or fewer polls (margin: SD 3.5, floor +/-6). Margin = REP minus DEM average, in points (positive = Republican lead). With n_polls = 1 the average is that poll.
